summary: Churchill Capital Corp IX, a SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing it cannot consummate a business combination by the August 6, 2026 deadline. The board determined to redeem all Class A ordinary shares held by public shareholders at the trust account per-share amount (including interest, net of permitted withdrawals and dissolution expenses up to $100,000). Warrants will expire worthless; the sponsor waived redemption rights. Following redemption, the company will dissolve and liquidate. The process is to occur within ten business days. Watch for the exact redemption price per share and any creditor claims under Cayman Islands law; risk-arb is moot.
